Ubamatamab's own randomised Phase 2 is weaker than the incumbent's registration trial: ORR 18% (9 of 50) and median PFS 2.9 months at 800 mg (ESMO 2025, abstract 1078P, data cut 2025-01-15) against Elahere's 42% (as gsk_mocertatug_rezetecan.csv reads MIRASOL) and 5.62 months (MIRASOL, Moore et al., N Engl J Med 2023, PMID 38055253)
column12: the 0.2 multiple is the arguable figure. Case for higher: the ORR ratio to Elahere is 0.43; MUC16 is on nearly every tumour, where Elahere's label covers the 36% of platinum-resistant patients who are FRalpha-high (as gsk_mocertatug_rezetecan.csv cites Matulonis et al., JCO 2023); responses at 800 mg lasted a median 10.5 months; and the platform tests combinations that could lift response. Case against: a 2.9-month PFS; no response in liver metastases; cytokine release syndrome in 85% of patients, managed with step-up dosing and sarilumab; and it would arrive about 2033 behind Rina-S, R-DXd, AZD5335, sofetabart mipitecan and mocertatug rezetecan
